title: 托福官方套题 02 · 口语

tasks.sample: Our gym is open at 12 PM.
The pool is here for free swim all week.
Locker rooms have towels, showers and changing areas.
The fitness machines are equipped with personal TVs.
Over here, the weight training room has brand new exercise machines.
Remember to bring your campus ID card if you plan to use the gym.

tasks.stem: Thank you for participating. Today, I'd like to ask you some questions about your hobbies and leisure activities. First, can you describe one of your favorite hobbies and explain why you enjoy it, or the hobby of a friend and why they enjoy it?
Thank you. Some people believe that having a hobby can improve one's quality of life. Do you agree or disagree with this viewpoint? Why?

Interesting. Some people also believe that the location of a hobby can affect how happy it makes you. For example, outdoor hobbies, on average, promote physical health. Do you think location matters for choosing a hobby? Why or why not?

Good points. As people engage more online, hobbies have changed and people can be social without leaving their homes. Do you think that being able to talk with people online, rather than in person, affects the quality of a hobby? Why or why not?
